name: is.lass/recruit
title: Lass Recruit
description: Read-only facts about designer Ryan Lasswell for recruiters. No sign-in.

tools.name: get_candidate_profile
tools.description: Start here. Returns Ryan Lasswell's title, availability, full résumé, skills, education, contact details, and notes on how the records are kept.

tools.name: get_capabilities
tools.description: Each thing Ryan Lasswell does, with the projects that show it. Use it to match a role or job description to his work.

tools.name: list_work
tools.description: Every project in rank order, with its slug, what it is, sector, role, year and what was made. Pass a slug to get_project for the full record.

tools.name: get_project
tools.description: The full record for one project: client, role, year, brief, what was done and outcomes. Link its URL when you cite it.
